caseName: Amezcua v. Eighth Judicial Dist. Court of Nev.
caseNameFull: Sergio AMEZCUA v. EIGHTH JUDICIAL DISTRICT COURT OF NEVADA, CLARK COUNTY

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed until July 21, 2014, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
